plain: To break up a group, such as an army

webster.text: To dismiss from military service; to break up a band, or body of men enlisted; as, to disband an army or a regiment; to disband troops.

more.text: To retire from military service; to separate; to break up; as, the army, at the close of the war, disbands.

example.quote: Were every nation except France now to disband its peace establishments, the same event might follow.
